# Health services

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Each health service's beds, where referrals were accepted and its open ED movements.

## What is on the screen

1. Services at a glance. Each service's share of beds in use. On a phone: services, beds and open ED journeys.
2. Statistics views. Network, Compare, Services, Wards, EDs, Teams and Weekly. Each opens its own page.
3. Compare. Opens Compare, with every ward and ED side by side.
4. Each service. Beds in use, pulled, closed and ready, with wards at the alert line. Open a service for its own figures.
5. Where referrals were accepted. Every referral on record, by the service that referred and the service that accepted it.
6. ED journeys open. People still in an ED or in transit, counted by service.

## On a phone

- Each service. Beds in use, wards at the alert line and ED journeys open. Open a service for its own figures.
- Amber dot. Says what an amber dot on a service means.
- Where referrals were accepted. Every referral on record, counted by the service that accepted it.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
